mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust labor market conditions, which historically correlate with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% per annum signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO are below 95% of their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (marked by low unemployment and high inflation), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates cooling demand for residential construction, which precedes a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as late-cycle expansion, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines below 95% of its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95% of its 12-month moving average signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the annualized inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals disinflation, which reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the annualized CPIAUCSL rate is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer purchasing power, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines below 95% of its 12-month moving average and UNRATE rises above 105% of its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates that the tightening is causing economic stress, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and rising FEDFUNDS, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines below 95% of its 12-month moving average.
